insider_template|transactionrecord|Order.description: Categorizes order timing as Suspicious, Regular, or Irregular. Selects 35% of rows.
insider_template|transactionrecord|Order.definition: ordertimepat = CASE WHEN ordervar > 1.8 THEN 'Suspicious' WHEN ordervar < 0.5 THEN 'Irregular' ELSE 'Regular' END

insider_template|transactionrecord|Order.description: Categorizes order type distribution as Market, Limit, or Mixed. Selects 34% of rows.
insider_template|transactionrecord|Order.definition: ordertypedist = CASE WHEN darkusage + offmkt > 0.3 THEN 'Limit' WHEN darkusage + offmkt < 0.1 THEN 'Market' ELSE 'Mixed' END

insider_template|transactionrecord|Wash.description: Level of suspected wash trading: Low, Medium, or High. Selects 32% of rows.
insider_template|transactionrecord|Wash.definition: json_extract(risk_indicators, '$.washsus') = CASE WHEN crossfreq > 0.08 OR darkusage > 0.3 THEN 'High' WHEN crossfreq > 0.04 OR darkusage > 0.2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END

insider_template|transactionrecord|Layer.description: Indicates whether layering is Suspected or Confirmed. Selects 64% of rows.
insider_template|transactionrecord|Layer.definition: json_extract(risk_indicators, '$.layerind') = CASE WHEN modfreq > 0.4 AND cancelpct > 0.25 THEN 'Confirmed' ELSE 'Suspected' END

insider_template|transactionrecord|Spoof.description: Probability that the transaction involves spoofing.

insider_template|transactionrecord|Front.description: Score measuring front-running risk on a 0-100 scale.

insider_template|transactionrecord|Momen.description: Signal strength for momentum ignition: Weak or Strong. Selects 50% of rows.
insider_template|transactionrecord|Momen.definition: json_extract(risk_indicators, '$.momentignit') = CASE WHEN ordervar > 1.5 OR crossfreq > 0.08 THEN 'Strong' ELSE 'Weak' END

insider_template|transactionrecord|Quote.description: Index measuring quote stuffing intensity from 0 to 1.

insider_template|transactionrecord|Marke.description: Pattern of participation around market close: Occasional or Frequent. Selects 53% of rows.
insider_template|transactionrecord|Marke.definition: json_extract(risk_indicators, '$.markclosepat') = CASE WHEN SUBSTR(transtime, 12, 2) >= '15' THEN 'Frequent' ELSE 'Occasional' END

insider_template|advancedbehavior|transl.description: ID beginning with IT followed by six digits.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Warn.description: Enforcement action taken is a warning. Selects 51% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Lega.description: Escalation level is Legal. Selects 26% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Reso.description: Resolution status is Resolved. Selects 32% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Fine.description: Penalty imposed is a fine. Selects 25% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Acti.description: Legal action status is Active. Selects 33% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Sett.description: Settlement status is Settled. Selects 32% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Seve.description: Reputational impact level is Severe. Selects 33% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Full.description: Business restriction scope is Full. Selects 32% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Comp.description: Remediation status is Completed. Selects 32% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Blac.description: Trading restriction type is Blackout. Selects 33% of rows.

insider_template|enforcementactions|Urge.description: Policy update need is Urgent. Selects 31% of rows.

insider_template|trader|Win percentage.description: Win percentage stored in the trading_performance JSON object.

insider_template|trader|Profit/loss rati.description: Profit/loss ratio stored in the trading_performance JSON object.

insider_template|trader|Risk level.description: Risk category stored in the risklevel object inside trading_performance.

insider_template|trader|Market Maker.description: A trader categorized as a market maker. Selects 27% of rows.

insider_template|trader|High frequency t.description: A trader whose frequency scope is High. Selects 35% of rows.

insider_template|compliancecase|Review f.description: Cadence between the last and next review dates. Selects 36% of rows.
insider_template|compliancecase|Review f.definition: REVFREQ = CASE WHEN CAST(JULIANDAY(NEXTREVDT) - JULIANDAY(LASTREVDT) AS INTEGER) <= 1 THEN 'Daily' WHEN CAST(JULIANDAY(NEXTREVDT) - JULIANDAY(LASTREVDT) AS INTEGER) <= 7 THEN 'Weekly' ELSE 'Monthly' END

insider_template|compliancecase|Review s.description: Next review date must be after last review date.

insider_template|compliancecase|Complian.description: Letter grade based on previous violation count. Selects 25% of rows.
insider_template|compliancecase|Complian.definition: COMPRATE = CASE WHEN PREVVIOL = 0 THEN 'A' WHEN PREVVIOL BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'B' WHEN PREVVIOL BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN 'C' WHEN PREVVIOL >= 5 THEN 'D' END

insider_template|compliancecase|Alert le.description: Alert level mapped from compliance rating grade. Selects 27% of rows.
insider_template|compliancecase|Alert le.definition: ALERTLVL = CASE WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'D' THEN 'Critical' WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'C' THEN 'High' WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'B' THEN 'Medium' WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'A' THEN 'Low' END

insider_template|compliancecase|Monitori.description: Intensity level assigned from alert level. Selects 32% of rows.
insider_template|compliancecase|Monitori.definition: MONITINT = CASE WHEN TRIM(ALERTLVL) = 'Critical' THEN 'Intensive' WHEN TRIM(ALERTLVL) = 'High' THEN 'Enhanced' ELSE 'Standard' END

insider_template|compliancecase|Investig.description: Priority computed from alert level and case status. Selects 34% of rows.
insider_template|compliancecase|Investig.definition: INVSTPRIOR = CASE WHEN TRIM(ALERTLVL) = 'Critical' OR TRIM(CASESTAT) = 'Investigation' THEN 'High' WHEN TRIM(ALERTLVL) = 'High' OR TRIM(CASESTAT) = 'Monitoring' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END

insider_template|compliancecase|Detectio.description: Detection method corresponding to the active surveillance system. Selects 33% of rows.
insider_template|compliancecase|Detectio.definition: DETECTMTH = CASE WHEN TRIM(SURVSYS) = 'Primary' THEN 'Automated' WHEN TRIM(SURVSYS) = 'Secondary' THEN 'Manual' WHEN TRIM(SURVSYS) = 'Multiple' THEN 'Hybrid' END

insider_template|compliancecase|Delayed.description: Cases with delayed regulatory filing and late broker report. Selects 12% of rows.

insider_template|compliancecase|Non-comp.description: Cases with non-compliant disclosure and incomplete or late broker report. Selects 20% of rows.

insider_template|compliancecase|Exchange.description: Warning exchange notification triggered by non-compliant disclosure or delayed filing. Selects 36% of rows.

insider_template|investigationdetails|To.description: Total number of connected entities plus communication addresses in the investigation circle. Selects 2% of rows.

insider_template|investigationdetails|Ne.description: Percentage of the total circle made up of connected entities.

insider_template|investigationdetails|Gr.description: Average of the pattern recognition, behavior, and network analysis scores.

insider_template|investigationdetails|Ma.description: Probability of market abuse calculated as the average of the four analysis scores scaled to a 0-1 range.

insider_template|investigationdetails|Sh.description: Shared contact method is Multiple when there is more than one communication address. Selects 31% of rows.

insider_template|investigationdetails|Re.description: Relationship map is Complete when both connected entities and addresses exist, Pending when neither exists, otherwise Partial. Selects 32% of rows.
insider_template|investigationdetails|Re.definition: CASE WHEN CAST(CONNENT AS INTEGER) > 0 AND COMMADDR > 0 THEN 'Complete' WHEN CAST(CONNENT AS INTEGER) = 0 AND COMMADDR = 0 THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Partial' END = TRIM(RELMAPSTAT)

insider_template|investigationdetails|Do.description: Documentation status mirrors relationship map status: Complete, Partial, or Incomplete. Selects 31% of rows.
insider_template|investigationdetails|Do.definition: CASE WHEN TRIM(RELMAPSTAT) = 'Complete' THEN 'Complete' WHEN TRIM(RELMAPSTAT) = 'Partial' THEN 'Partial' ELSE 'Incomplete' END = TRIM(DOCUSTAT)

insider_template|investigationdetails|In.description: Investigation registration is Active when documentation is Complete, otherwise Preliminary. Selects 58% of rows.
insider_template|investigationdetails|In.definition: CASE WHEN TRIM(DOCUSTAT) = 'Complete' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Preliminary' END = TRIM(REGINV)

insider_template|investigationdetails|Ev.description: Evidence strength is Strong at or above 0.75 market abuse probability, Moderate at or above 0.4, and Weak below 0.4. Selects 35% of rows.
insider_template|investigationdetails|Ev.definition: CASE WHEN MKTABPROB >= 0.75 THEN 'Strong' WHEN MKTABPROB >= 0.4 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Weak' END = TRIM(EVIDSTR)

insider_template|compliancecase,enforcem.description: Penalty amount divided by the linked compliance risk score.

insider_template|enforcementactions,inve.description: Enforcement case escalated to Legal and linked investigation evidence is Strong.

insider_template|compliancecase,investig.description: Average of compliance model confidence and normalized investigation pattern-recognition score.

insider_template|advancedbehavior,compli.description: Case under intensive monitoring with linked behavior pattern similarity below 0.5.

insider_template|sentimentandfundamental.description: Order variability scaled by the information leak score of the related sentiment record.

insider_template|investigationdetails,se.description: Difference between average news/social sentiment and normalized investigation behavior score.

insider_template|trader,transactionrecor.description: Order variability scaled by trader average position as a share of account balance.
